Open Football — ZOXEXIVO/open-football
Author: Artemov Ivan (ZOXEXIVO) and contributors

Pinned commit: 9bb183af844980ff0c398597868b635aff191674

Next90sim v93 modifies/translates selected SupportOffer and pass-safety
algorithms into assets/open-football-adapter.js. Original Rust modules
are included here. Metres, centered X/Z coordinates and a stateless API
replace the original engine context and native coordinate system.
Bounded support targets and pass utility integration are Next90sim changes.
The complete Rust match engine is not included or running in this website.

Next90sim v94 expands the selected ports: pressure intensity and counter-press
weights; tactical phase windows; primary/cover/help defence; marker evasion;
dribble space and duel score; through-ball lead/race/corridor; arrival and
pursuit steering; rolling decay, timed pass flight; body contact and goal-net
progressive damping. Original modules are included alongside this notice.
Changes include metre/second conversions, bounded anticipation, calibrated
net dimensions, documented role-attribute proxies and constrained replay
integration. Contextual transition stories and keeper spill handling are
Next90sim additions, not represented as verbatim Open Football modules.

The default live-possession generator (assets/possession-engine.js) is a
Next90sim integration using the selected ports. It is not an upstream Rust
module or a claim that the complete native match engine has been compiled.
